basic_info.description: Must-see property for those who seek flexibility, space, and opportunity. Main 3 bed, 2 bath unit and accompanying studio ADU in prime Potrero Hill. Built in 1904, 489-495 Utah is a three-unit (TIC) building with a legal cottage (accessory dwelling unit- ADU), situated between Mariposa and 17th. Stripped down to the studs in 2018, Unit 489 features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, wide-plank hardwood floors which extend throughout the home, and the sunny living room benefits from windows on two sides. The kitchen includes Carrara marble countertops, generous cabinet space, sleek built-in shelving, and Thermador appliances. The primary bedroom has a large closet, windows on two sides, and direct access to a private deck and yard (common area). This property is being sold with the studio apartment-ADU (unit 495) with similar design and finishes. See listing #425011322. Combined sales price of $1,297,000. ADU listed separately at $299,000. Combined square footage 1465. Perfect for WFH, in-laws, passive income, gear, yoga, man/woman cave, startup, you name it. Come take a look.
